name: Unavowed Ambiguities?: a Plea for Reassessing the Discourse on the Gift.
headline: Unavowed Ambiguities?: a Plea for Reassessing the Discourse on the Gift.
description: The article examines the deconstructive focus of French philosopher Jacques Derrida (1930-2004) on the gift's purity and the aporia this entails and the discussion of primacy of givenness in phenomenology of religion.
